title: Implement Property-Based Testing
description: Runnable property-based testing examples with Hypothesis (Python), fast-check (JavaScript) and jqwik (Java): simple properties, composite strategies, serialization round-trips and stateful model-based testing.
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables de property-based testing con Hypothesis (Python), fast-check (JavaScript) y jqwik (Java): propiedades simples, estrategias compuestas, ciclos de serialización y testing con estado basado en modelo.
